title: Ionic Conductivity Induced by Photooxidation of Ferrocene in Polymer Film Containing Organotin Compound
abstract: Abstract                Ionic conductivity of poly(ethyl methacrylate) film containing photooxidizable dibutylferrocene and bromotributylstannane was induced by UV light irradiation in contact with the anion-conducting polymer film containing a cobaltocemum salt. The enhanced ionic conductivity decreased in the dark.
